assets.title: 25-Gb/s 6.5-pJ/bit 90-nm CMOS-driven multimode optical link

assets.conditions: 850nm VCSEL; standard90nm bulk CMOS driver and receiver ICs; commercial GaAs optoelectronic devices

assets.title: A112Gb/s Radiation-Hardened Mid-Board Optical Transceiver in130-nm SiGe BiCMOS for Intra-Satellite Links
